description: Privacy-preserving age checks built on the OpenID Connect standard — part of Scytáles’ European Commission mandate for safer digital services across Europe.

hero.headline: Privacy-Preserving Age Verification for a Safer Digital Europe
hero.sub: Scytáles’ Age Verification Connector is built on the secure and widely adopted OpenID Connect standard, designed for pan-European deployment and aligned with eIDAS 2.0 privacy principles.
bullets: Confirm age without oversharing personal data
OpenID Connect for secure, interoperable integration
Official EU Commission age verification mandate

showcase.statCopy: Prove an age threshold without revealing birth date, name, or address

statement: Official technological developers of pan-European Age Verification solutions for the European Commission, with deep expertise in privacy-preserving credentials and high-assurance identity.

benefits.title: Enterprise-Grade Security
benefits.body: Trusted by the European Commission. GDPR compliant, privacy-first architecture with OpenID Connect standards.

benefits.title: Delightful User Experience
benefits.body: Frictionless verification that your users will love. Fast, simple, and works seamlessly across all devices.

benefits.title: 100% FREE to Start
benefits.body: No credit card required. Up to 1,000 free verifications per month, forever. Scale as you grow with transparent pricing.

benefits.title: Developer-Friendly
benefits.body: Comprehensive documentation, SDKs for popular frameworks, and responsive support to get you up and running fast.

benefits.title: Scale with Confidence
benefits.body: Battle-tested infrastructure handling millions of verifications. Auto-scaling, 99.9% uptime, and global CDN delivery.

benefits.title: Global Coverage
benefits.body: Verify users across multiple countries with support for local identity providers and international compliance standards.

steps.title: Age Check Needed
steps.body: User redirected to the connector using the OpenID Connect flow.

steps.title: Request Age Proof
steps.body: The connector requests age, via QR code or deeplink.

steps.title: User Approves & Sends Proof
steps.body: Wallet cryptographically sends a verifiable token.

steps.title: Verification & Token Issuance
steps.body: The connector validates and returns proof of age attestation to your website or app.

cards.title: Simple Integration
cards.body: Easy for your website or app to consume.

cards.title: Strong Security
cards.body: Built on OpenID Connect and OpenID4VP.

cards.title: Enhanced Privacy
cards.body: Your website or app never sees personal data.
